ms.report:
Milestone 2 Report: Marketing and Community Outreach
Project: Cardano Tech Week Argentina (ID: 1300054)
Milestone Cost: ₳30,000
1. Participant Registration Goal: Exceeded by Over 50%
The primary objective of the marketing and outreach campaign was to achieve a minimum of 200 registered participants. This goal was significantly surpassed, demonstrating the campaign's effectiveness.
・Acceptance Criterion: A verified participant registration list with at least 200 confirmed entries.
・Evidence: The official event page on the Luma platform serves as the verified, third-party registration list. It publicly displays 301 attendees, exceeding the target by 101 participants (+50.5%).
・Evidence Link 1: Verified Participant Registration List (Luma Event Page)
・https://luma.com/jcsgq39k

This result is the ultimate proof of a successful marketing strategy and directly satisfies the core acceptance criterion for this milestone. The following sections detail the specific activities that led to this outcome.
2. Marketing Campaign & Partnership Amplification
A multi-faceted digital marketing campaign was executed, leveraging both direct social media outreach and strategic partnerships to maximize visibility and drive registrations.
・Acceptance Criterion: Publication of 10+ promotional posts and collaboration evidence with at least 2 partner organizations.
・Evidence: A comprehensive campaign was launched across Twitter (X), LinkedIn, and other platforms, far exceeding the 10-post minimum. The campaign's reach was significantly amplified by key ecosystem partners who shared and endorsed the event.
